Name: Stardew Brewery
Author: Cylonn
Description:
My first mod on the Nexus!

[b]NOTE: This mod is currently only for Stardew Valley 1.2![/b] It will be updated as soon as Entoarox Framework and SpaceCore are updated.

[b]Stardew Brewery[/b] adds a new Brewery to Robin's construction options.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]A new building!
[*]Interior can be decorated with furniture
[*]Casks can be used inside
[*]Support for seasonal exteriors
[/list]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]spacechase0[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-entoarox-framework.4228/]Entoarox Framework[/url]﻿ by [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/entoarox.624175/]Entoarox[/url]﻿
[/list]

[b]Installation:
[/b]   Simply unzip directly into your [b]Mods[/b] directory.


[b]Optional Files:[/b]
[list]
[*]Hudson Valley Recolors: Compatibility patch for Hudson Valley. Simply unzip, navigate to the folder matching your Hudson Valley color scheme and move the [b]﻿StardewBrewery[/b] folder inside into your [b]Mods[/b] directory, and overwrite all files when prompted to do so.
[*]Seasonal Vanilla: Seasonal variants of the Vanilla texture. Simply unzip directly into your [b]Mods[/b] directory.
[*]Elle's Seasonal Buildings Recolors: Compatibility patch for Elle's Seasonal Buildings. Unzip, navigate to the folder matching your Elle's Seasonal Buildings color scheme and move the [b]StardewBrewery [/b]folder inside into your [b]Mods[/b] directory, and overwrite all files when prompted to do so.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Wall furniture does not currently work.
[*]Interior windows do not glow during daytime like other windows in the game.
[*]The Brewery builds instantly despite Robin saying she'll get started on it tomorrow.
[*]Placing furniture from Custom Furniture inside the Brewery can cause a crash, best to avoid doing that for now.
[/list]

[b]Credits:
[/b][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url]﻿ for SMAPI and helping me understand C# (and also enduring my endless questions)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]spacechase0[/url]﻿ for SpaceCore and enduring my endless questions
[*][url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/entoarox.624175/]Entoarox[/url]﻿ for Entoarox Framework and answering some of my dumber questions
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/44734342]Cat[/url]﻿ for helping me with C# Reflection
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/51094596]oomps62[/url]﻿ for her amazing sprite work!
[/list]
This project would have never happened without these people. Thanks so much guys! <3
